{
  "name": "pi-tools",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Joel's pi extensions, Effect/XState session reader, repo autopsy, skill shortcuts, web search, url-to-markdown, linear-tracker, shortlink QR",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "pi-package",
    "pi",
    "pi-coding-agent"
  ],
  "bin": {
    "pi-session-recall-mcp": "./session-reader/mcp-server.ts",
    "pi-session-recall-mcp-http": "./session-reader/mcp-http-server.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "1.26.0",
    "effect": "4.0.0-beta.99",
    "express": "5.2.1",
    "ioredis": "^5.6.1",
    "langfuse": "^3.38.6",
    "qrcode": "^1.5.4",
    "xstate": "5.32.5",
    "zod": "4.3.6"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-agent-core": "~0.74.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "~0.74.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "~0.74.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "~0.74.0",
    "@sinclair/typebox": "*"
  },
  "pi": {
    "skills": [
      "./skills"
    ],
    "extensions": [
      "./repo-autopsy/index.ts",
      "./session-reader/session-reader.ts",
      "./skill-shortcut/skill-shortcut.ts",
      "./aliases/aliases.ts",
      "./secrets/secrets.ts",
      "./web-search/web-search.ts",
      "./url-to-markdown/index.ts",
      "./bash-timeout/index.ts",
      "./linear-tracker/index.ts",
      "./shortlink-qr/index.ts"
    ]
  },
  "scripts": {
    "brain:check": "pi-notes brain check",
    "test:session-reader": "node --test session-reader/capture-paths.test.ts session-reader/session-reader.test.ts session-reader/scope-discovery.test.ts session-reader/mcp-server.test.ts session-reader/mcp-http-server.test.ts session-reader/install-executor-memory-service.test.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "5.0.6",
    "@types/node": "24.13.3",
    "typescript": "7.0.2"
  }
}
